title: ExplorerStylesScreen
responsibility: Displays purpose-named application style assignments, their resolved values and actual usage, followed by foundation tokens; legacy aliases are omitted.

inputs.name: ExplorerStylesScreen.index
inputs.description: The prepared history index of the selected repository: its branches, revisions, units, benchmarks, profiles, legacy reports, truncated flag and problems. This screen and its frame never read it, so it has no effect on what is shown.

revisions.subject: Read Styles roles from the app token config
revisions.author: Mara Lind
gaps: No verification record is attached to this commit.

inputs.name: ExplorerStylesScreen.head
inputs.description: The selected revision, of which the frame reads only registry: when registry.available is false it shows a 'No registry at this revision' notice in place of the styles, with registry.gap (or a line naming the short scope.commit when there is no gap) as its message. The style tokens come from the page's stylesheets, so this revision supplies none of them.

registry.gap: no unit registry is stored at this revision

inputs.name: ExplorerStylesScreen.parent
inputs.description: The first parent of the selected commit as a full revision, or null at the branch tip and for a first commit. This screen and its frame never read it.

registry.gap: no unit registry is stored at this revision

inputs.name: ExplorerStylesScreen.scope
inputs.description: The shown scope: the screen passes scope.commit to each style group as its resetKey, so a group re-expands when the commit changes, and the frame reads scope.mode for its data-mode and scope.commit for the short commit in the missing-registry message when registry.gap is absent. Location, branch, tip, atTip, parent and summary are not read here.

summary.subject: Read Styles roles from the app token config
summary.author: Mara Lind
gaps: No verification record is attached to this commit.

inputs.name: ExplorerStylesScreen.route
inputs.description: The current explorer address: the frame reads its branch, category, entity and helper to close an open source dialog when the address changes, and builds the missing-registry notice's link from it. The screen itself does not read it.

inputs.name: ExplorerStylesScreen.entities
inputs.description: The units of the selected revision as the explorer lists them, with the entities the shown commit removed. This screen and its frame never read it.

inputs.name: ExplorerStylesScreen.lens
inputs.description: The host's entity lens: the frame gives its href to the missing-registry notice, which calls it while rendering its link. This screen never calls relations, evidence, behavior or history.

inputs.name: ExplorerStylesScreen.client
inputs.description: The revision reader the host supplies; neither this screen nor its frame calls it.

inputs.name: ExplorerStylesScreen.mediaBase
inputs.description: The URL prefix that the frame joins with an archived source file's media name to fetch its text; it is read only while a source dialog is open, and this screen never opens one.

inputs.name: ExplorerStylesScreen.onroute
inputs.description: The callback that the missing-registry notice's 'Stay on this revision' action calls with the location the notice links to; this screen never calls it otherwise.

outputs.name: ExplorerStylesScreen
outputs.description: The Styles page with one group per token group: the color, typography and spacing roles show their base variable with its resolved value, specimen, treatments and where it is used, and every other --hx- token appears once with its declared value and specimen. Only --hx- custom properties declared in :root rules are listed, legacy aliases are omitted, and a stylesheet the page cannot read contributes nothing.

errors.name: Host reader error
errors.description: Thrown by the host's lens.href while the missing-registry notice renders (when head.registry.available is false), or by its onroute callback when that notice's action is clicked; the screen catches neither.
